preparation: Keep states/territories 1–8; clip display to 112–154.5 E, 44.2–9 S; simplify 0.025 degrees preserving topology; round coordinates to four decimals. Excludes Other Territories and remote islands outside the display extent. Statistical state totals remain unchanged.
projection: Australia Albers equal-area; cartogram geometry first projected to EPSG:3577 then resized with area proportional to registered dairy farms and relocated for legibility.
